purpose: Rank what is still genuinely missing after deliberate over-acquisition through MM-DATA-157. Mechanism coverage and possession of rights-clear raw data are scored separately.

gaps.gap: authorised real-site shot-linked intervention and verified-recovery histories
gaps.target: shot/cycle -> machine/tool/cavity -> material lot -> process actuals -> cavity/tool signals -> physical defect -> operator/engineer action -> subsequent verified good-state recovery
gaps.why: Many corrective-action studies now exist, but few provide reusable cycle-level before/fault/action/recovery raw histories.

gaps.target: first answer, distractor, response time, confidence, retry, lesson exposure and later transfer performance from actual MouldMaster users
gaps.why: External learner proxies cannot establish MouldMaster item difficulty, discrimination or learning gain.

gaps.gap: blinded independent engineer judgments on MouldMaster cases
gaps.target: at least three independent injection-moulding engineers per blinded case before app output is revealed
gaps.why: Public expert labels and operational labels do not substitute for MouldMaster-specific comparative validation.

gaps.gap: rights-clear multi-machine / multi-mould raw anomaly and quality corpus
gaps.target: multiple machines and tools with cycle identity, normal/fault labels, actual cause, material identity and physical outcome
gaps.why: Cross-machine evidence is now strong, but the best industrial corpora are restricted, request-only or paper-only.

gaps.gap: natural wear -> maintenance action -> verified recovery raw histories
gaps.target: longitudinal component/tool degradation plus maintenance trigger, exact intervention and post-maintenance signal/quality recovery
gaps.why: Wear progression is now substantially over-covered; the missing link is real repair/cleaning/replacement followed by quantified recovery.

gaps.target: zone actual temperatures, heater current/output, thermocouple actuals, valve-pin commanded/actual position, alarms, nozzle/manifold state, cavity response and part quality
gaps.why: We now have multiple independent hot-runner experiments but little reusable raw device-state telemetry.

gaps.gap: longitudinal cooling fouling -> cleaning -> quality/energy recovery
gaps.target: flow, inlet/outlet temperature, pressure drop, water quality, fouling accumulation, cleaning/descaling action and recovery over weeks/months
gaps.why: Cooling state and contamination mechanisms are well supported, but long-duration raw maintenance histories remain scarce.

gaps.target: per-shot, per-cavity pressure/temperature/weight/dimensions/defects plus runner/gate state and cavity identity
gaps.why: Multiple strong physical studies now exist; author-delivered or open raw cavity-by-cavity data would turn mechanism confidence into reusable validation evidence.

gaps.gap: deterministic admission of public raw candidates
gaps.target: retrieve, hash, profile and rights-review OpenMMS, EPP, PASCOE/imPURE, RWTH PCR, LEGO appendix and other executable records
gaps.why: For these families the marginal value now comes from data engineering/admission, not more searching.

gaps.gap: exact material-lot / conditioning linkage to individual moulding runs
gaps.target: supplier/grade/lot/COA, moisture, drying, regrind/recycled fraction and rheology linked to cycle IDs and outcomes
gaps.why: Exact grades and deliberate material changes are now broad, but routine real-production lot identity remains rare.

gaps.target: component-specific actuals, interface/core position, sequencing, hot-runner actuals and physical bond/dimensional outcomes
gaps.why: The process family is no longer under-researched, but most useful raw production data remain request-only or confidential.

gaps.gap: rights-clear measured assessment cases with real psychometric outcomes
gaps.target: trace/case assessment items sourced from rights-clear measured evidence, followed by actual learner response statistics
gaps.why: More question writing without real learner calibration now has low marginal value.

deprioritised: additional generic single-machine process traces without physical outcomes
more simulation-only data in already-covered processes
additional papers from the same experiment or institution/tooling program when no new physical outcome is added
out-of-domain anomaly datasets when injection-moulding-specific evidence is available
